selected_evidence.requirement: opsbot account created on node1 and node2
selected_evidence.summary: useradd succeeded on both nodes; id opsbot shows uid=1000(opsbot) on each with password locked via passwd -l

selected_evidence.requirement: opsbot on node1 has SSH key-based access to run commands as opsbot on node2
selected_evidence.summary: Generated ed25519 keypair for opsbot on node1, installed its public key into opsbot's authorized_keys on node2, and confirmed opsbot@node1 can BatchMode-SSH (key only) into opsbot@node2 and run whoami/hostname successfully

selected_evidence.requirement: key-based authentication required for opsbot on both systems (password/interactive auth rejected)
selected_evidence.summary: Added Match User opsbot sshd drop-in on both nodes setting PasswordAuthentication/KbdInteractiveAuthentication no and AuthenticationMethods publickey; sshd -T -C user=opsbot confirms effective policy on both nodes; forcing PreferredAuthentications=password from node1 to node2 was rejected with 'Permission denied (publickey)'

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart with proof of changed boot identity and recovered opsbot/SSH state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id c2f29441... captured before restart; reboot acknowledged; node unreachable mid-reboot; node back with new boot_id 4812cf4c...; post-restart check shows sshd active, opsbot intact, and key-based SSH to node2 still functioning

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart with proof of changed boot identity and recovered opsbot/SSH/cluster state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 377b5195... captured before restart; reboot acknowledged; node unreachable mid-reboot; node back with new boot_id 96e2d5c3...; post-restart check confirms sshd active, opsbot/authorized_keys intact, pubkey-only policy still enforced, and node1->node2 key-based SSH works while password auth is still rejected
